description: SubscriberState enum defines exactly PENDING_KYC, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED, TERMINATED, PORT_OUT_REQUESTED, PORTED_OUT and no other values.
steps: Inspect the SubscriberState enum definition
Assert the member set equals exactly the 6 documented states
Assert no additional or missing members exist

description: A declarative FSM transition table maps each valid (from_state, to_state) pair; calling transition(current_state, target_state) with a pair not in the table raises InvalidSubscriberStateException.
steps: Call transition() with a documented valid pair and assert it succeeds
Call transition() with an undocumented pair (e.g. TERMINATED -> ACTIVE)
Assert InvalidSubscriberStateException is raised

description: Domain types for Subscriber, Subscription, PlanVersion, BillingRecord, StateTransition, PortOutEvent, CSROverride, and DealerMaster are defined with typed fields (no Any), and money fields typed as Decimal.
steps: Instantiate each domain type with valid typed data
Assert every monetary field's declared type is Decimal
Attempt to construct a monetary field with a float and assert it is rejected or coerced with a type error

description: The Types module has zero imports from Config, Repository, Service, API, or UI.
steps: Run grep -rn 'from.*config|from.*repository|from.*service|from.*api|from.*ui' on the types module
Assert no matches are found

description: Unit tests instantiate each domain type with valid data and assert field types, including that monetary fields reject non-Decimal input.
steps: Write a parametrized unit test over all 8 domain types
Assert successful construction with valid data
Assert a TypeError/ValidationError on a non-Decimal monetary value

description: Config module exposes a typed settings object with fields for DB path, KYC stub flag values, dealer-fail code, and MNP stub flag values, loaded from environment variables with documented defaults.
steps: Import the settings object without setting any env vars
Assert every field has a documented, non-null default value
Assert the field types are concrete (str/bool), not Any

description: SQLite connection is configured with PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL applied at startup.
steps: Start the app against a temp SQLite file
Query 'PRAGMA journal_mode' on the connection
Assert the result is 'wal'

description: Config module imports only from Types (no Repository/Service/API/UI imports).
steps: Run grep -rn 'from.*repository|from.*service|from.*api|from.*ui' on the config module
Assert no matches are found

description: A unit test asserts that an unset environment variable falls back to its documented default value.
steps: Unset the KYC_STUB_FLAG env var
Load settings
Assert the resulting value equals the documented default

description: A unit test asserts that the dealer-fail trigger code and KYC/MNP stub flags are read as exact string/boolean constants usable by the activation service.
steps: Set DEALER_FAIL_CODE=DEALER-FAIL in the environment
Load settings
Assert settings.dealer_fail_code == 'DEALER-FAIL' exactly

description: Logger emits each log entry as a single JSON object with at minimum timestamp, level, message keys.
steps: Call logger.info('test event')
Capture the emitted line
Parse it as JSON and assert timestamp, level, message keys are present

description: A logged mobile number is masked to show only the last 4 digits (e.g., ******7890); the full unmasked number never appears in the emitted JSON.
steps: Log an event with mobile_number='9876547890'
Capture the emitted JSON line
Assert the raw number is absent and a masked form ending in 7890 is present

description: A logged Aadhaar reference and PAN reference are masked using the same partial-reveal rule and never appear unmasked in output.
steps: Log an event containing an aadhaar_ref and a pan_ref value
Capture the emitted JSON line
Assert neither raw value appears as a substring

description: A unit test captures log output for a payload containing all three PII fields and asserts none of the raw values are present as substrings of the emitted JSON.
steps: Log one event containing mobile_number, aadhaar_ref, and pan_ref together
Assert none of the three raw values appear in the captured output

description: Logger module imports only from Types and Config.
steps: Run grep -rn 'from.*repository|from.*api|from.*ui' on the logger module
Assert no matches are found

description: Every non-health API route requires an authenticated principal with a role; unauthenticated requests receive HTTP 401.
steps: Call a protected route with no Authorization header
Assert response status is 401

description: A subscriber-role request to a CSR-only or admin-only endpoint receives HTTP 403.
steps: Authenticate as a subscriber
Call an admin-only endpoint
Assert response status is 403

description: A subscriber requesting another subscriber's subscription data (by ID mismatch) receives HTTP 403.
steps: Authenticate as subscriber A
Request subscriber B's subscription resource
Assert response status is 403

description: A CSR or admin principal can access endpoints scoped to their own role without a 403.
steps: Authenticate as CSR
Call a CSR-scoped endpoint
Assert response status is not 403

description: An integration test exercises all four cases above against a running test client.
steps: Run an integration test suite covering unauthenticated, wrong-role, cross-subscriber, and correct-role cases
Assert all four expected outcomes

description: GET /health returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing a status: 'ok' field.
steps: Call GET /health
Assert response status is 200
Assert response body contains status == 'ok'

description: A test measures response latency and asserts it is under 1000ms.
steps: Time a call to GET /health
Assert elapsed time < 1000ms

description: /health requires no authentication.
steps: Call GET /health with no Authorization header
Assert response status is 200, not 401

description: A test starts the app and calls /health immediately after startup completes, asserting success without retries beyond the documented backoff policy.
steps: Start the application
Call GET /health immediately after startup signal
Assert 200 is returned within the documented retry/backoff budget

description: Repository exposes create_subscriber, get_subscriber_by_id, and get_subscriber_by_mobile functions backed by SQLite.
steps: Call create_subscriber with valid data
Call get_subscriber_by_id and get_subscriber_by_mobile
Assert both return the same created record

description: A partial unique index exists on (mobile_number) restricted to state=ACTIVE, enforcing at most one ACTIVE subscription per mobile number at the database level.
steps: Inspect the SQLite schema for the partial unique index
Assert the index expression is restricted to state='ACTIVE'

description: DealerMaster table is seeded with at least 5 valid dealer codes plus the DEALER-FAIL sentinel code on application startup/migration.
steps: Run the migration/seed step
Query the DealerMaster table
Assert at least 5 valid codes and the DEALER-FAIL sentinel are present

description: A unit test inserts two subscriptions with the same mobile number both attempting ACTIVE state and asserts the second raises a database integrity error.
steps: Insert subscription 1 with mobile X in ACTIVE state
Attempt to insert subscription 2 with mobile X in ACTIVE state
Assert an IntegrityError is raised on the second insert

description: Repository module imports only from Types and Config.
steps: Run grep -rn 'from.*service|from.*api|from.*ui' on the repository module
Assert no matches are found

description: Repository exposes create_plan_version, publish_plan_version, get_published_version, and list_versions functions.
steps: Call each of the four functions against a test DB
Assert each returns the expected shape without error

description: Calling any update/delete operation against a row already marked published=true raises an error at the repository level (no UPDATE statement executed against published rows).
steps: Publish a plan version
Attempt to call an update function against that version
Assert an error is raised and no UPDATE was executed

description: list_versions returns all historical versions for a plan in ascending version-number order, none of them deleted.
steps: Create 3 versions of a plan across time
Call list_versions
Assert all 3 are returned in ascending version order

description: A unit test attempts to mutate a published plan version's price field directly and asserts it fails.
steps: Publish a version with price P
Attempt to directly mutate its price field
Assert the operation fails and price remains P

description: Repository exposes create_billing_record and list_billing_records_for_subscription; no update_billing_record or delete_billing_record function exists.
steps: Inspect the repository module's public functions
Assert create/list exist and no update/delete function is defined

description: Monetary columns are stored and retrieved as Decimal, never float, verified by a unit test comparing exact Decimal equality after round-trip.
steps: Create a billing record with a Decimal amount
Fetch it back
Assert exact Decimal equality (no float rounding drift)

description: Attempting to run a raw UPDATE or DELETE against the billing_records table (e.g., via a direct SQL statement in a test) either fails via a DB constraint/trigger or is asserted absent from the codebase.
steps: Search the codebase for UPDATE/DELETE statements against billing_records
Assert none exist outside of test fixtures/teardown

description: A unit test creates two billing records for the same subscription and asserts both remain retrievable (no overwrite).
steps: Create billing record 1 and billing record 2 for the same subscription
Call list_billing_records_for_subscription
Assert both records are present

description: Repository exposes append_state_transition and list_state_transitions_for_subscription; no update/delete function exists for state transitions.
steps: Inspect the repository module's public functions
Assert append/list exist and no update/delete function is defined

description: Repository exposes create_port_out_event, get_active_port_out_event, and close_port_out_event (closing sets an end status, it does not delete the row).
steps: Create a port-out event, fetch it as active, then close it
Assert the row still exists with an end status set, not deleted

description: A unit test appends 3 state transitions for one subscription and asserts all 3 remain retrievable in chronological order.
steps: Append 3 state transitions for one subscription
Call list_state_transitions_for_subscription
Assert all 3 are returned in chronological order

description: create_port_out_event stores the request timestamp and computes/stores the cooling-period end timestamp exactly 7 days later.
steps: Create a port-out event at timestamp T
Assert the stored cooling-period end equals T + 7 days exactly

description: Repository exposes create_csr_override and list_csr_overrides_for_subscription; no update/delete function exists.
steps: Inspect the repository module's public functions
Assert create/list exist and no update/delete function is defined

description: Every CSROverride record stores a non-null actor (CSR user ID), a non-null timestamp, and a non-null reason code.
steps: Create a CSROverride record
Assert actor, timestamp, and reason_code are all non-null on the stored row

description: A unit test creates two overrides for the same subscription and asserts both remain retrievable independently.
steps: Create override 1 and override 2 for the same subscription
Call list_csr_overrides_for_subscription
Assert both are present and independent

description: Repository exposes activation_funnel_counts, monthly_churn_rate, plan_mix_distribution, and arpu_trend query functions.
steps: Call each of the four functions against a test DB with seeded data
Assert each returns without error and in the expected shape

description: activation_funnel_counts returns counts per funnel stage (registered, KYC-passed, dealer-passed, MNP-passed, activated) that sum consistently (each stage count <= the prior stage count).
steps: Seed data covering all funnel stages
Call activation_funnel_counts
Assert each stage's count is <= the prior stage's count

description: monthly_churn_rate returns one value per calendar month derived from PORTED_OUT/TERMINATED transitions in that month divided by active base at month start.
steps: Seed PORTED_OUT/TERMINATED transitions across two calendar months
Call monthly_churn_rate
Assert one value per month matching the expected ratio

description: All returned monetary aggregates (e.g., ARPU) are Decimal, never float.
steps: Call arpu_trend
Assert every returned monetary value's type is Decimal

description: Registering with a valid mobile number, identity-proof reference, and plan type creates a subscription in PENDING_KYC state.
steps: Call register() with valid inputs
Fetch the created subscription
Assert its state is PENDING_KYC

description: Registering a mobile number that already has an ACTIVE subscription is rejected with a specific error (not a generic 500).
steps: Create an ACTIVE subscription for mobile X
Call register() again for mobile X
Assert a specific DuplicateActiveSubscriptionError is raised

description: Registering with a malformed mobile number (not matching the expected digit pattern) is rejected before any database write.
steps: Call register() with an invalid mobile string
Assert a validation error is raised
Assert no row was written to the subscriber table

description: A unit test verifies the identity-proof reference is persisted but is masked when logged.
steps: Call register() with an identity-proof reference
Assert the raw reference is stored in the DB
Assert any log line emitted during registration masks the reference

description: Creating a new plan starts an unpublished draft version at version number 1.
steps: Call create_plan()
Assert the resulting version has version_number == 1 and published == False

description: Publishing a draft version marks it published=true and makes it the active version returned by get_published_version.
steps: Publish a draft version
Call get_published_version
Assert it returns the just-published version

description: Attempting to edit a published version's price or terms raises a specific PlanVersionImmutableError rather than succeeding.
steps: Publish a version
Call the edit function on it
Assert PlanVersionImmutableError is raised

description: Requesting a change to a published plan instead creates a new draft version (version number incremented) with the requested fields, leaving the prior published version unchanged and retrievable.
steps: Publish version 1
Request a change producing version 2 as a new draft
Assert version 1 is unchanged and retrievable, and version 2 exists as a draft

description: Only an admin-role principal can create or publish a plan version; a non-admin attempt is rejected.
steps: Call create_plan()/publish() as a non-admin principal
Assert an authorization error is raised

description: A plan change exactly at a billing-cycle boundary produces a pro-rata charge of 0.00 for the boundary day attribution per the documented formula.
steps: Call calculate_pro_rata() with a change date equal to the cycle boundary
Assert the returned charge equals Decimal('0.00')

description: A plan change mid-cycle in a 28-day February (non-leap year) and in a 29-day February (leap year, e.g., 2028) both produce correct, independently-asserted pro-rata amounts using the actual days-in-month for that year.
steps: Call calculate_pro_rata() for a mid-February 2025 change (28 days)
Call calculate_pro_rata() for a mid-February 2028 change (29 days)
Assert each result matches the expected value for its respective days-in-month

description: The calculated charges_total is always >= 0 for every generated test case (NFR-08 invariant), including a downgrade scenario that could naively produce a negative credit-only figure.
steps: Run a table of upgrade and downgrade scenarios including a credit-heavy downgrade
Assert charges_total >= 0 for every scenario

description: All intermediate and final amounts are Decimal typed; a static/type check confirms no float is used in the calculation module.
steps: Run mypy/static check over the pro-rata module
Assert no float literal or float-typed variable is used for money

description: A unit test table-drives at least 6 boundary-date scenarios including the leap-year case and asserts exact expected Decimal values.
steps: Define 6+ scenarios covering month-start, month-end, and leap-year February
Run calculate_pro_rata() for each
Assert each result equals its exact expected Decimal value

description: Activation with KYC-verified flag, a valid dealer code, and MNP-success flag transitions the subscription to ACTIVE and appends a StateTransition record.
steps: Call activate() with all-pass stub flags
Assert the subscription state is ACTIVE
Assert a StateTransition record was appended for PENDING_KYC -> ACTIVE

description: Activation with an unverified KYC flag is rejected with reason code KYC_UNVERIFIED and the subscription remains PENDING_KYC.
steps: Call activate() with kyc=not-verified
Assert the raised/returned error reason code is KYC_UNVERIFIED
Assert the subscription state is still PENDING_KYC

description: Activation with dealer code DEALER-FAIL is rejected with reason code DEALER_INVALID and the subscription remains PENDING_KYC.
steps: Call activate() with dealer_code='DEALER-FAIL'
Assert the reason code is DEALER_INVALID
Assert the subscription state is still PENDING_KYC

description: Activation with the MNP-fail flag is rejected with reason code MNP_FAILED and the subscription remains PENDING_KYC.
steps: Call activate() with mnp=fail
Assert the reason code is MNP_FAILED
Assert the subscription state is still PENDING_KYC

description: Attempting to activate a subscription that is not in PENDING_KYC (e.g., already ACTIVE) raises InvalidSubscriberStateException.
steps: Activate a subscription successfully once
Call activate() again on the now-ACTIVE subscription
Assert InvalidSubscriberStateException is raised

description: A test attempts to activate two registrations for the same mobile number concurrently/sequentially and asserts only one reaches ACTIVE (double-activation race, NFR-07).
steps: Register two subscriptions for the same mobile number
Attempt to activate both
Assert exactly one ends ACTIVE and the other fails with a duplicate/integrity error

description: POST /api/admin/plans (admin role) creates a draft plan version and returns HTTP 201.
steps: POST /api/admin/plans as admin with valid payload
Assert response status is 201

description: POST /api/admin/plans/{id}/publish publishes a draft and returns HTTP 200 with published: true.
steps: POST /api/admin/plans/{id}/publish
Assert response status is 200 and body.published == true

description: PUT /api/admin/plans/{id} on an already-published version returns HTTP 409 with an immutability error message.
steps: Publish a version
PUT /api/admin/plans/{id} attempting to edit it
Assert response status is 409

description: GET /api/admin/plans returns the full version history including superseded versions.
steps: Create and publish multiple versions
GET /api/admin/plans
Assert the response includes every version, not just the latest

description: A non-admin principal calling any of the above endpoints receives HTTP 403.
steps: Call each endpoint as a non-admin principal
Assert response status is 403 in every case

description: POST /api/subscribers/register with valid input returns HTTP 201 with the new subscriber ID and state PENDING_KYC.
steps: POST /api/subscribers/register with valid payload
Assert response status is 201
Assert body contains subscriber_id and state == 'PENDING_KYC'

description: POST /api/subscribers/{id}/activate with all stub flags passing returns HTTP 200 with state ACTIVE.
steps: POST /api/subscribers/{id}/activate with all-pass flags
Assert response status is 200
Assert body state == 'ACTIVE'

description: POST /api/subscribers/{id}/activate with a failing stub flag returns HTTP 422 with a machine-readable reason code (KYC_UNVERIFIED, DEALER_INVALID, or MNP_FAILED).
steps: POST /api/subscribers/{id}/activate with a failing flag
Assert response status is 422
Assert body contains one of the three documented reason codes

description: POST /api/subscribers/{id}/activate on an already-ACTIVE subscriber returns HTTP 409.
steps: Activate a subscriber successfully
POST /activate again on the same subscriber
Assert response status is 409

description: All requests/responses are validated against typed request/response models (no untyped dicts).
steps: Inspect the route handler signatures
Assert request and response bodies use typed Pydantic models, not raw dict

description: UI lists all plan versions for a plan with a visible published/draft badge per version.
steps: Load the plan catalog screen
Assert each listed version shows a published or draft badge

description: Admin can submit a form to create a new draft version from the current published version's fields.
steps: Click 'create new version'
Assert the form is pre-filled from the published version and submits successfully

description: Attempting to edit a field on a published version in the UI is disabled/blocked, with an inline message directing the admin to create a new version instead.
steps: Attempt to edit a field on a published version row
Assert the input is disabled and an inline message appears

description: Publishing a draft from the UI updates the visible published badge without a full page reload error.
steps: Click 'publish' on a draft version
Assert the badge updates to 'published' without a page error

description: A plan-change request on a subscription younger than the configured minimum-tenure period is rejected with reason code MIN_TENURE_NOT_MET and no BillingRecord is created.
steps: Create a subscription younger than the minimum-tenure period
Call commit_plan_change()
Assert reason code MIN_TENURE_NOT_MET and no BillingRecord was created

description: A plan-change request on a SUSPENDED subscription is rejected with a visible reason code and no BillingRecord is created.
steps: Suspend a subscription
Call commit_plan_change()
Assert rejection with a visible reason code and no BillingRecord created

description: A preview call returns the computed pro-rata amount without persisting a BillingRecord or changing the subscription's plan.
steps: Call preview_plan_change() on an eligible subscription
Assert the pro-rata amount is returned
Assert no BillingRecord exists and the subscription's plan is unchanged

description: A commit call on an eligible ACTIVE subscription past minimum tenure updates the subscription's current plan and persists exactly one new BillingRecord matching the previewed amount.
steps: Preview a plan change
Commit the same plan change
Assert the plan is updated and exactly one matching BillingRecord was created

description: Two consecutive commits for the same subscription each produce their own independent BillingRecord (append-only), and the prior record is never modified.
steps: Commit a plan change
Commit a second plan change on the same subscription
Assert two independent BillingRecords exist and the first is unchanged

description: Suspending an ACTIVE subscription transitions it to SUSPENDED and appends a StateTransition record.
steps: Call suspend() on an ACTIVE subscription
Assert state is SUSPENDED and a StateTransition record was appended

description: Resuming a SUSPENDED subscription transitions it back to ACTIVE and appends a StateTransition record.
steps: Call resume() on a SUSPENDED subscription
Assert state is ACTIVE and a StateTransition record was appended

description: Attempting to suspend a subscription that is not ACTIVE (e.g., already SUSPENDED or PENDING_KYC) raises InvalidSubscriberStateException.
steps: Call suspend() on a PENDING_KYC subscription
Assert InvalidSubscriberStateException is raised

description: Attempting to resume a subscription that is not SUSPENDED raises InvalidSubscriberStateException.
steps: Call resume() on an ACTIVE subscription
Assert InvalidSubscriberStateException is raised

description: Requesting port-out on an ACTIVE subscription transitions it to PORT_OUT_REQUESTED, creates a PortOutEvent, and appends a StateTransition record.
steps: Call request_port_out() on an ACTIVE subscription
Assert state is PORT_OUT_REQUESTED, a PortOutEvent exists, and a StateTransition was appended

description: Cancelling a port-out request within the 7-day window returns the subscription to ACTIVE and closes the PortOutEvent with status CANCELLED_WITHIN_WINDOW.
steps: Request port-out, then cancel within 7 days
Assert state returns to ACTIVE and the PortOutEvent status is CANCELLED_WITHIN_WINDOW

description: Finalizing a port-out request after the 7-day window has elapsed transitions the subscription to PORTED_OUT and closes the PortOutEvent with status FINALIZED.
steps: Request port-out, advance time past 7 days, then finalize
Assert state is PORTED_OUT and the PortOutEvent status is FINALIZED

description: Attempting to finalize a port-out request before the 7-day window has elapsed is rejected with a specific reason code.
steps: Request port-out, then finalize before 7 days have elapsed
Assert rejection with a specific reason code (e.g., COOLING_PERIOD_ACTIVE)

description: Requesting port-out on a subscription that is not ACTIVE raises InvalidSubscriberStateException.
steps: Call request_port_out() on a SUSPENDED subscription
Assert InvalidSubscriberStateException is raised
